rules.source_annotations: Selected inventory/donor literal missing and unknown markers standardized to na; historical aliases remain readable. Clinical uncertain significance is unchanged.
rules.identity: Recorded IDs, trimmed without case folding, qualified by cohort; no name fallback or cross-cohort linkage
rules.receipt: Present sample ID required for outcome; missing/unknown tokens and formulas are not receipt evidence
rules.outcome: One uniformly randomly selected numeric eligible diagnosis plasma sample per patient, including zero candidates; reject negatives; no endpoint substitution or recalculation
rules.sample_selection: Independent seeded RNG per cohort-qualified patient; candidates sorted by cohort/patient/sample-ID hash, source row breaks repeated-ID ties; select once across predictors; no redraw for zero or missing clinical values; all-missing outcomes retain one selected eligible row with unavailable outcome
rules.log_analysis: Predictor-specific complete pairs with positive selected sample outcomes; nonpositive outcomes counted; no pseudocount
rules.clinical_validation: Unknown/missing markers remain unavailable; malformed numeric clinical annotations or values outside approved ranges block the cohort
rules.blast_conversion: Source fractions in [0,1] multiplied by 100 exactly once
rules.categorical_discordance: Retrospective sex from selected sample, subtype first nonmissing diagnosis, with discordance counts retained; CIRCALL conflicting metadata block the cohort
rules.inference: Separate log10(recorded outcome) OLS for each requested pair; HC3 continuous uncertainty, categorical omnibus, ordinary 95% intervals; no multiplicity adjustment.
rules.correction: None, investigator requested unadjusted primary p-values; report the number of requested comparisons; no BH or other multiplicity adjustment.
rules.sensitivity: Selected peripheral-blast Spearman only; two-sided asymptotic unadjusted secondary analysis
rules.pooling: Descriptive only for requested pairs shared by both cohorts with comparable confirmed units; no controls or pooled inference.
rules.volume: Legacy extraction_input_volume_ml is available specimen volume; entire volume used when extracted; retain recorded ng/mL endpoint; never use blood_volume_ml
rules.unavailable: Unavailable requested values/tests retain explicit coverage and skipped reasons; do not substitute follow-up values.
rules.empty_diagnosis_rows: Skip and count unassigned diagnosis rows only when participant/sample/DNA IDs and clinical/extraction measurements are unavailable; actual records with invalid IDs still block.
rules.outcomes: Read all five recorded endpoints from the same selected plasma row; preserve cfDNA-based sample selection and log10 positive-outcome analysis; no recalculation, pseudocount or endpoint-specific redraw.
rules.sampling_time: Morning before 12:00, afternoon from 12:00; recorded local clock time, no timezone inference or processing-delay derivation.
rules.scope: Only the investigator-requested pairs: 31 CIRCALL and 30 retrospective; cytology then cytospin remains one predictor; no retrospective marrow or unrequested coverage rows.
rules.retrospective_scope: Diagnosis plasma only; no matching or metadata borrowing from blood-pellet, marrow or follow-up rows. Blood counts on other specimen rows do not supply missing plasma values.
rules.comparison_switches: Each cohort/outcome/predictor has a JSON true/false switch. False removes its testing, descriptions and figures; pooling requires both cohort switches enabled. Preparation, sample selection and integrity checks remain unchanged. All switches may be false; settings remain in audit and workbook Definitions.
